name: Ancient Eel 92
author: rrr63
description: Cyan button that scales up on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #EBF5EE to #EBF5EE, transform becomes scale(1.2) rotate(5deg), left becomes 150%.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ancient Eel 92</title>
<style>
/* Ancient Eel 92 by rrr63 — https://uiverse.io/rrr63/ancient-eel-92 */
.button {
  padding: 10px 35px;
  background-color: #EBF5EE;
  font-weight: bolder;
  border: 0px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 5px;
  transition: all .2s ease-in-out .1s;
}

.button:hover {
  background-color: #EBF5EE;
  transform: scale(1.2) rotate(5deg);
}

.button:before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  background-color: #78A1BB;
  height: 180%;
  top: -30%;
  left: -40%;
  transform: rotateZ(20deg);
  width: 40px;
  transition: left .2s ease-in-out, left 0s;
}

.button:after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  background-color: #283044;
  height: 180%;
  top: -30%;
  left: -40%;
  transform: translateX(-40px) rotateZ(20deg);
  width: 40px;
  transition: left .2s ease-in-out, left 0s;
}

.button:hover:after {
  left: 150%;
  transition: left .3s ease-in-out;
}

.button:hover:before {
  left: 150%;
  transition: left .3s ease-in-out;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Click here ..
</button>

</body>
</html>
